exercises.explanationUz:
⚠ 16-BET SKANDA YO'Q - 3-mashqning
  boshi va fe'llar ro'yxati
  yo'qolgan. Javoblar MATN MA'NOSI
  va coursebook 30-bet 'Up, Up and
  Away!' hikoyasiga qarab.

  5 vertolyot tomga QO'NDI → landed
  6 uchuvchi yordam so'rab RADIO
    ORQALI CHAQIRDI → radioed
    (hikoyada: 'I've already
    radioed for help')
  7 sumka shoxda OSILIB TURARDI →
    hanging (hikoyada: 'hanging
    from a branch')
  8 taksichi cholni OLIB KETDI →
    picked up (hikoyada: 'Bob
    picked her up in his car')


⚠ 'TO LAND':

  = qo'nmoq (samolyot, vertolyot).


⚠ 'TO RADIO FOR HELP':

  = radio orqali yordam chaqirmoq.


⚠ 'TO HANG FROM':

  = ... dan osilib turmoq.


⚠ 'TO PICK SB UP':

  = birovni (mashinada) olib ketmoq.


⚠ KITOBDA IMLO XATOSI:

  'buidling' → to'g'risi 'building'.

items.textEn: The helicopter ___ on the roof of the building and five men jumped out.
The pilot ___ for help, then pulled his coat around his shoulders to keep warm.
There was a big black bag ___ from one of the tree branches.
items.whyUz: ⚠ 'hanging from a branch' - V-ing shakli ('There was a bag hanging').

items.textEn: A taxi driver ___ the old man and took him to hospital.

exercises.instructionEn: Fill in the appropriate adjective from the list: horrible, wintry, delighted, unharmed, wonderful, amazing, comfortable.
exercises.instructionUz: Ro'yxatdan mos sifatni qo'ying: horrible, wintry, delighted, unharmed, wonderful, amazing, comfortable.
exercises.explanationUz:
HIKOYA SIFATLARI (coursebook
  28-bet 9-mashq).

  wonderful   = ajoyib (tajriba)
  comfortable = qulay (kreslo)
  horrible    = dahshatli (tush)
  amazing     = hayratlanarli
    (omad)
  unharmed    = zarar ko'rmagan
    (o'g'il)
  wintry      = qishki (kun)
  delighted   = xursand (yuzlar)


⚠ 'A STROKE OF LUCK':

  = kutilmagan omad.
  'what an amazing stroke of luck'
  → 'AN' (unli).


⚠ 'FAST ASLEEP':

  = qattiq uxlab qolgan.


⚠ 'UNHARMED':

  'un-' + 'harm' (zarar) + '-ed' =
  zarar ko'rmagan, sog'-omon.


⚠ 'WINTRY':

  winter → wintry (e tushadi) =
  qishki, sovuq.


⚠ 'TO HOLD SB TIGHTLY':

  = birovni mahkam quchoqlamoq.


⚠ 'TO LET SB GO':

  = qo'yib yubormoq.


⚠ 'DELIGHTED':

  = juda xursand (happy dan kuchli).

items.sentence: It was a ___ experience that I will never forget.
items.uz: Bu hech qachon unutmaydigan ajoyib tajriba edi.

items.sentence: I only realised how tired I was when I sat down in the ___ chair, and soon I was fast asleep.
items.uz: Qanchalik charchaganimni faqat qulay kresloga o'tirganimda angladim va tez orada qattiq uxlab qoldim.

items.sentence: Then I woke up and realised that it had all been a ___ dream.
items.uz: Keyin uyg'ondim va hammasi dahshatli tush bo'lganini angladim.

items.sentence: Thinking back, I realised what a(n) ___ stroke of luck it had been that I didn't catch that plane.
items.uz: O'ylab qarasam, o'sha samolyotga ulgurmaganim qanday hayratlanarli omad bo'lganini angladim.

items.sentence: I was so glad that the police had found my son ___, that I held him tightly and wouldn't let him go.
items.uz: Politsiya o'g'limni sog'-omon topganidan shu qadar xursand edimki, uni mahkam quchoqlab qo'yib yubormasdim.

items.sentence: It was a cold ___ day when the stranger arrived in the town of Corkham.
items.uz: Notanish odam Korkxem shahriga kelganida sovuq qishki kun edi.

items.sentence: It gave me such pleasure watching the children's ___ faces as they opened their presents.
items.uz: Bolalarning sovg'alarini ochayotgandagi xursand yuzlarini ko'rish menga shunday zavq berdi.

exercises.explanationUz:
SIFAT yoki RAVISh? (coursebook
  28-bet qoidasi)

  SIFAT - OTNI tasvirlaydi:
    heavy footsteps (qanday qadam?)
    He was careful ('be' dan keyin
    SIFAT!)
  RAVISh - FE'LNI tasvirlaydi:
    smiled sweetly (qanday jilmaydi?)
    gently picked up
    closed softly
    did well


⚠ 'BE + SIFAT':

  'He WAS careful' - 'be' fe'lidan
  keyin SIFAT (ravish EMAS).


⚠ 'GOOD' → 'WELL':

  good = sifat, well = ravish.
  'She did WELL' ('did good' -
  XATO).


⚠ 'SUDDENLY' - GAP BOShIDA:

  'Suddenly, they heard ...' -
  ravish butun gapni tasvirlaydi.


⚠ 'A PUPPY':

  = kuchukcha. 'TINY' = mitti.


⚠ 'FOOTSTEPS':

  = qadam tovushlari.


⚠ 'A VASE':

  = guldon. Brit. /vɑːz/.

items.textEn: The girl smiled sweet/sweetly as she accepted the flowers.
items.uz: Qiz gullarni qabul qilarkan shirin jilmaydi.

items.textEn: Sudden/Suddenly, they heard the sound of someone coming up the stairs.
items.uz: To'satdan ular kimningdir zinadan ko'tarilayotgan tovushini eshitishdi.
items.whyUz: ⚠ Gap boshida, butun gapni tasvirlaydi → RAVISh.

items.textEn: He gentle/gently picked up the tiny puppy.
They were scared when they heard the heavy/heavily footsteps.
items.uz: Ular og'ir qadam tovushlarini eshitganda qo'rqib ketishdi.

items.textEn: He closed the door soft/softly because he didn't want to wake the children.
items.uz: U bolalarni uyg'otmaslik uchun eshikni sekin yopdi.

items.textEn: He was careful/carefully not to drop the vase.
items.uz: U guldonni tushirib yubormaslikka ehtiyot bo'ldi.

items.textEn: She did good/well in her tests.

exercises.instructionEn: Read the text and write the words in brackets in their correct form. (Todd at the ski resort)
exercises.instructionUz: Matnni o'qing va qavsdagi so'zlarni to'g'ri shaklda yozing. (Todd chang'i kurortida)
exercises.explanationUz:
SIFAT → RAVISh: +LY
  (coursebook 28-bet 10-mashq).

  bright → brightLY
  soft → softLY
  careful → carefulLY
  violent → violentLY
  loud → loudLY
  quick → quickLY
  brave → braveLY

  ⚠ 'FAST' - O'ZGARMAYDI:
  fast (sifat) = fast (ravish).
  'wasn't going very FAST'.
  ('fastly' - YO'Q!)


HIKOYA - TODD va ChANG'I LIFTI:

  Todd chang'i kurortiga keladi,
  liftdan tushayotib sirpanadi,
  lift ryukzagini ilib, uni havoga
  ko'taradi. Kimdir liftni
  to'xtatadi. Ryukzak liftda osilib
  qoladi.


⚠ 'A SKI RESORT':

  = chang'i kurorti.
  'a ski lift' / 'a chair lift' =
  chang'i lifti (kreslo lift).


⚠ 'TO HAND SB STH':

  = birovga biror narsani uzatmoq.


⚠ 'TO SLIP':

  = sirpanmoq.


⚠ 'TO SCREAM':

  = qichqirmoq. 'cries' = qichqiriq.


⚠ 'UPWARDS':

  = yuqoriga.


⚠ 'TO HURRY OVER TO SB':

  = birovning oldiga shoshilmoq.

items.textEn: The sun shone ___ (bright) as Todd's mother drove him to the ski resort.

"Don't forget this," she said, handing him his rucksack. Todd threw the bag over his shoulder and went towards the ski lift. Snow began to fall ___ (soft) as the lift took him to the top of the mountain.
Todd jumped off ___ (careful), but he slipped on the ice and fell.
The chair lift behind him caught his rucksack and pulled him ___ (violent) into the air.
Todd screamed ___ (loud) as the lift started again and carried him upwards.
Luckily, it wasn't going very ___ (fast) and someone heard his cries and stopped the lift.
items.whyUz: ⚠ 'fast' - sifat va ravish BIR XIL. 'fastly' YO'Q.

items.textEn: A skier hurried ___ (quick) over to him. "Are you alright?" he asked.
"Yes," said Todd ___ (brave), "but I don't know how I'm going to get my rucksack back!" He looked up. The bag was still hanging from the ski lift.

exercises.instructionEn: Put the verbs in brackets into the past simple or the past continuous.
exercises.instructionUz: Qavsdagi fe'llarni past simple yoki past continuous shakliga qo'ying.
exercises.explanationUz:
PAST SIMPLE yoki PAST CONTINUOUS?
  (coursebook 29-bet qoidasi)

  PAST CONTINUOUS (was/were +
  V-ing) - DAVOM ETAYOTGAN fon:
    'was lying WHEN she got home'
    'were watching WHEN the pizza
     arrived'
  PAST SIMPLE - QISQA, TUGALLANGAN
  voqea (uzib kiradi):
    'replied', 'sat', 'gasped'

  ⚠ QOLIP: was/were + V-ing WHEN
  + past simple.
  ⚠ 'AS I was getting on' = ...
  ayotganimda.


NOQONUNIY FE'LLAR:

  sit → SAT
  hear → HEARD
  shake → SHOOK
  fall → FELL
  go → WENT
  lie → lying (ie → y!)


⚠ 'TWO YEARS AGO' → PAST SIMPLE.


⚠ 'TO GASP IN AMAZEMENT':

  = hayratdan nafas yutmoq.


⚠ 'A BRIDE':

  = kelin. 'a lace dress' = to'rli
  ko'ylak. 'a bouquet' = guldasta.


⚠ 'TO RESCUE':

  = qutqarmoq. 'on its own' =
  o'zi (yordamsiz).


⚠ 'TO SHAKE ONE'S HEAD':

  = bosh chayqamoq (yo'q).


⚠ 'THE HALL':

  = dahliz, koridor.


⚠ ANKARA:

  = Turkiya poytaxti.

items.textEn: The letter ___ (lie) on the table when she got home.
items.whyUz: ⚠ Uyga kelganda xat YOTARDI (davomiy) → past continuous. lie → lyING.

items.textEn: They ___ (watch) a film when the pizza arrived.
items.whyUz: ⚠ Pitsa kelganda film KO'RAYOTGAN edilar → 'were watching'.

items.textEn: "I don't know where she is," he ___ (reply).
items.whyUz: ⚠ Bir martalik javob → past simple. reply → replIED.

items.textEn: Dr Lewis ___ (sit) down and took her shoes off.
items.whyUz: ⚠ Ketma-ket voqealar ('and took') → past simple. sit → SAT.

items.textEn: Melinda ___ (gasp) in amazement when she saw the beautiful diamond ring.
items.whyUz: ⚠ Ko'rganda nafas yutdi - qisqa → past simple.

items.textEn: The bride was wearing a white lace dress and she ___ (hold) a bouquet of roses.
items.whyUz: ⚠ Tasvir - 'was wearing ... and was holding' → past continuous.

items.textEn: She was reading the letter when she ___ (hear) a noise behind her.
items.whyUz: ⚠ O'qish davomida tovush ESHITDI (uzib kirdi) → past simple. hear → HEARD.

items.textEn: The fireman ___ (climb) the tree to rescue the cat when it jumped down on its own.
She ___ (shake) her head and walked away.
items.whyUz: ⚠ Ketma-ket voqealar → past simple. shake → SHOOK.

items.textEn: It was twelve o'clock and Mrs Stone ___ (wait) for her daughter to come home.
items.whyUz: ⚠ Soat 12 da KUTAYOTGAN edi → past continuous.

items.textEn: Mr Smith ___ (paint) the hall when his wife walked through the front door.
The waiter was carrying a plate and two glasses when he ___ (fall).
items.whyUz: ⚠ Olib ketayotganda YIQILDI → past simple. fall → FELL.

items.textEn: She ___ (go) to Ankara two years ago.
items.whyUz: ⚠ 'two years ago' → past simple. go → WENT.

items.textEn: As I ___ (get) on the bus yesterday, I fell and hurt my foot.
items.whyUz: ⚠ 'As I was getting on' = chiqayotganimda → past continuous.

items.textEn: Mary ___ (decide) to buy her mother the necklace for her birthday.

patterns.formula: X was/were + V-ing when Y + V2.
patterns.exampleEn: They were watching a film when the pizza arrived.
patterns.exampleUz: Pitsa kelganda ular film ko'rayotgan edilar.

patterns.formula: As X was + V-ing, X + V2.
patterns.exampleEn: As I was getting on the bus, I fell.

patterns.formula: It was a + SIFAT + OT that I will never forget.
patterns.exampleEn: It was a wonderful experience that I will never forget.
patterns.exampleUz: Bu hech qachon unutmaydigan ajoyib tajriba edi.
